mutation.description: A root view freezes the timeline at v159. The timeline is then tombstoned by stamping a non-null tombstoned_at into timelines/<ULID>/manifest.json (the repo's only tombstone mechanism).

expected.frozen_lineage_resolves: drill-down from the frozen root still succeeds and is byte-identical to the pre-tombstone drill-down
expected.refresh_surfaces_tombstone: any fresh render of the live timeline (slug selection) fails with a diagnostic naming the tombstone ('timeline '<slug>' is tombstoned')
